moments.title: Queen's John Deacon is 75!
moments.blurb: Legendary Queen bassist and songwriter John Deacon celebrates his 75th birthday today, August 19th.

angles.name: Bassline King
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the man behind some of Queen's biggest basslines, John Deacon! Another One Bites the Dust, I Want to Break Free... pure genius.

angles.name: Quiet Genius
angles.copy: He might have been the quiet one, but John Deacon's impact on Queen is undeniable. Wishing the bass legend a very happy 75th birthday today!

moments.title: Robert Plant Turns 78
moments.blurb: Led Zeppelin frontman Robert Plant will celebrate his 78th birthday tomorrow, August 20th.

angles.name: Golden God
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the Golden God himself, Robert Plant, turns 78! What's your all-time favourite Led Zeppelin track?

angles.name: Voice of a Generation
angles.copy: From the raw power of Led Zeppelin to his incredible solo career, Robert Plant is a true icon. Happy 78th for tomorrow!
